protocol: Score all runs with the frozen TEXBAT cleanStatic q70 PRN-local GRU and receiver-quality contract v1. For each clean run, fit local conformal reference pools on the first 60% of complete event bins, fit event thresholds on the next 20%, hold out the final 20%, freeze, and only then open DS4/DS8 score CSVs.
hypothesis: Conditioning finite-sample local tail probabilities on causal receiver origin and tracking-age state reduces clean false alarms without degrading buffered spoofing detection or first-detection delay relative to a matched global conformal detector.
